summary: Sandbach United fell to a frustrating 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir, with Saul Shotton grabbing a late consolation goal but ultimately unable to salvage the result. The Bach created several chances throughout the match but were undone by defensive lapses, soft free kicks conceded, and poor marking in the box that proved costly. Next up is a trip to Stafford Town on Saturday as Sandbach look to bounce back from this disappointing performance.
